city_record.name: City Record Online
city_record.query: Procurement-section Solicitation notices with a start_date inside the window

definitions.solicitation_notice: One City Record Solicitation notice, counted once per request_id, by its publication (start) date.
definitions.response_window: Calendar days from the notice's publication date to its printed due date. Blank or invalid due dates, rolling placeholders (year 2090 or later) and due dates before publication are left out and counted in `excluded`.
definitions.usable_due_date_share: Notices with a usable due date divided by all the agency's solicitation notices in the window.
definitions.registered_contract: One Checkbook NYC registered contract, counted once per prime contract id, by its registration date. The amount is the original registered amount, not an award and not a payment.
definitions.median_original_registered_amount: Median of the original registered amounts of the contracts counted in amount_eligible.
definitions.agency_identity: Agencies are named by the engine's canonical agency id. A name the engine has not reviewed keeps its own id and is marked identity not_reviewed.

no_solicitation_notices.text: No solicitation notice under this agency's name was printed in the City Record in this window. Some agencies buy through PASSPort or print awards instead.

no_usable_due_date.text: This agency's solicitation notices in this window carry no usable due date (blank, a rolling placeholder, or before publication), so no response window can be read.

no_registered_contracts.text: No registered contracts are listed under this agency's name in Checkbook NYC in this window.

no_contract_amounts.text: This agency's registered contracts in this window carry no usable amount, so no median can be read.

identity_not_reviewed.text: This agency name is not in CityScroll's reviewed agency list; figures are matched on the name as printed.

Health and Hospitals Corporation.basis: The engine already routes the longer form "NYC Health and Hospitals Corporation" to this id; Checkbook prints the same public benefit corporation without the NYC prefix.

City University of New York.basis: The City Record prints the body as "City University"; Checkbook spells out the full name. The separate "City University Construction Fund" is not mapped.
